```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("../data/bdqtest_term_versions.csv")

for term_type in sorted(df["Type"].dropna().unique()):
    print(f"## {term_type}\n")

    group = df[df["Type"] == term_type].sort_values("Label")

    for _, row in group.iterrows():
        print(f"**{row['Label']}**\\")
        print(f"{row['Description']}\n")
```
